turns.question: Using 2025 as the baseline, did any of those six stocks have unusual sessions in that same window? Name the sessions and the features that made each one unusual. Anomaly scores are neither forecasts nor explanations.

report.markdown:
**Yes—CRCL, COIN and CRWV had flagged sessions** in the 20-session window, **February 12–March 12, 2026**, using 2025 as the baseline. The returned results include the sessions below; they are not an exhaustive list. [1]

The feature values below are **robust z-scores relative to the baseline—not percentage returns**. Positive values indicate above-baseline features; negative values indicate below-baseline features. They describe the unusual combinations, not their causes. [1]

| Stock | Session | Anomaly score | Features that stood out (robust z-scores) |
|---|---|---:|---|
| CRCL | 2026-02-25 | 4.567 | 1-day return +21.71; 5-day return +7.49; 20-day volatility +8.05; log-volume deviation +5.02. [1] |
| CRCL | 2026-03-09 | 0.578 | 1-day return +6.09; 5-day return +3.85; 20-day volatility +7.26. [1] |
| COIN | 2026-02-13 | 1.582 | 1-day return +10.26; 20-day volatility +4.93; log-volume deviation +2.74. [1] |
| COIN | 2026-02-25 | 0.934 | 1-day return +8.39; 5-day return +2.83; 20-day volatility +5.89; log-volume deviation +1.57. [1] |
| COIN | 2026-03-04 | 1.062 | 1-day return +8.92; 5-day return +3.16; 20-day volatility +6.50; log-volume deviation +1.72. [1] |
| CRWV | 2026-02-24 | 0.567 | 1-day return +5.68; 5-day return +2.12; 20-day volatility +5.82. [1] |
| CRWV | 2026-02-27 | 0.798 | 1-day return −11.85; 5-day return −2.80; 20-day volatility +6.50; log-volume deviation +3.48. [1] |
| CRWV | 2026-03-04 | 1.023 | 1-day return +4.12 alongside 5-day return −4.74; 20-day volatility +6.54. [1] |
| CRWV | 2026-03-11 | 0.613 | 1-day return +5.96; 20-day volatility +4.68. [1] |

**Limitations:** The scan flagged 58 sessions across the top-50 universe but returned only the 25 highest-scoring sessions. NFLX, BABA and GS did not appear in that returned subset; this does **not** establish that they had no flagged sessions. Anomaly scores are neither forecasts nor explanations. [1]
